hints.Don't cry over spilled milk: Knock over a glass and watch milk spill, start to sob, then shrug, wipe away the tears and move on.
hints.Let sleeping dogs lie: Tiptoe past a sleeping dog, finger on your lips, and then shake your head at someone who wants to wake it.
hints.Beggars can't be choosers: Hold out a hand begging for something, get a little, reject it with a sniff, and then be shown how silly that is.
hints.Don't bite the hand that feeds you: Feed someone by hand, then bite their hand, and be told off by waving a finger at the biter.
hints.The pen is mightier than the sword: Hold a sword and a pen, fight, then have the pen win by writing something that makes the sword drop.
hints.Barking dogs seldom bite: Bare your teeth and crouch as a fierce dog, show a human flinching, and then gently show the dog does nothing at all.
hints.Kill two birds with one stone: Throw a single stone, watch two birds fall from the sky, and look extremely pleased with yourself.
hints.Strike while the iron is hot: Hold a hammer, pick up a glowing metal bar, hit it quickly with all your force, and hurry before it cools.
hints.A bird in the hand is worth two in the b: Hold one bird in your hand, point at two in a bush, and shake your head, tightening your grip on the one.
hints.Don't look a gift horse in the mouth: Receive a horse as a gift, then open its mouth to check its teeth, and get scolded for being rude.
hints.A rolling stone gathers no moss: Roll like a boulder down a hill, show green fuzz growing on a still stone next to it, and not on the rolling one.
hints.Absence makes the heart grow fonder: Wave goodbye to a lover, walk away, long for them with a hand on your heart, and run back in a hug.
hints.Don't count your chickens before they ha: Count eggs excitedly, then watch one crack open and a chick appear, and look embarrassed.
hints.A watched pot never boils: Stare at a pot on a stove, tap your foot and check again and again, and stay bored while nothing happens.
hints.Don't put all your eggs in one basket: Carry a basket full of eggs, trip and watch them all smash, then split them into several baskets.
hints.Every cloud has a silver lining: Look up at a dark stormy cloud, sad, then see a bright line shine around it and smile.
hints.Birds of a feather flock together: Flap in a group of birds that all look the same, and chase away one that looks different.
hints.A picture is worth a thousand words: Wave your hands in lots of gestures at someone who still looks lost, then draw a frame in the air and show it in a single glance.
hints.Too many cooks spoil the broth: Many people stir the same pot and add salt, one after the other, then taste and spit it out.
hints.When in Rome, do as the Romans do: Enter a place and look around, then copy what everyone else does, wearing a toga and eating with your fingers.
hints.The grass is always greener on the other: Look over a fence with envy at the grass, jump over, look back and see yours is greener.
hints.Curiosity killed the cat: Be a cat that sniffs and pokes at a box, looks in, and falls down flat.
hints.You can't teach an old dog new tricks: Tell an old dog to sit and roll over, and show it staring blankly and scratching its ear.
hints.Rome wasn't built in a day: Stack bricks one by one, stop to wipe your forehead, check the clock, and show many days passing.
hints.Actions speak louder than words: Show one person making big gestures but doing nothing, then another who quietly does something big and helpful.
hints.Easy come, easy go: Pick money up from the ground with joy, then let it slip through your fingers and wave goodbye.
hints.Better late than never: Check your watch, run in a rush, arrive when everyone is leaving, then smile with relief and sit down.
hints.Practice makes perfect: Fail at a task many times, wipe your sweat, try again and again, and finally do it smoothly.
hints.Two heads are better than one: Struggle alone to lift a heavy box, then join a friend and carry it easily together.
hints.Honesty is the best policy: Break something, hide it, feel guilty, then confess with raised hands and look relieved.
hints.Time is money: Tap your watch, then drop a coin from your hand for every tick.
hints.Don't judge a book by its cover: Hold a plain book with a bored face, then open it and gasp, amazed at what is inside.
hints.Out of sight, out of mind: Wave goodbye to someone walking away, then look blank as if they never existed.
hints.Slow and steady wins the race: Walk very slowly like a tortoise while a fast rabbit sleeps, and cross the finish line first.
hints.The early bird catches the worm: Wake at dawn with a big stretch, flap like a bird, and pull a wiggly worm out of the ground.
hints.Look before you leap: Stand at the edge of a ditch, look carefully left, right and down, then jump safely across.
